=== hover on a method with its doc comment
-- script/main --
class Bag {
  // Adds n of an item; returns how many there are now.
  add(id: string, n: number): number { return n }
}
export function main(): number {
  const b = new Bag()
  return b.ad‸d("herb", 2)
}

=== definitions cross modules
-- script/util --

-- script/main --

export function main(): string { return sh‸out("hi") }

=== fields through an interface

=== references of a field across modules

=== the outline
-- script/main --
const LIMIT = 3
interface Named { readonly name: string; greet(): string }
export class Bell implements Named {
  name = "bell"
  private rung = 0
  constructor() {}
  greet(): string { return "ding" }
}
type Names = string[]
export function main(): number { return LIMIT }
-- symbols --
constant LIMIT
interface Named
  field name
  method greet
class Bell
  field name
  field rung
  method constructor
  method greet
type Names
function main

=== a comment at the end of the line above isn't a doc comment
